notes:
v0.6.41: ship the node-portal per-app help pages (flrig, fldigi, js8call, wsjtx, scan).

The v0.6.40 node-portal install only had 3 templates
(index.html, apps.html, wifi.html). The help route
/help/<app_name> returns 500 because the help pages
(flrig.html, fldigi.html, js8call.html, wsjtx.html)
didn't exist in the overlay — they were on g90digi but
never checked in. scan.html is needed for the /scan
POST result.

This v0.6.41 pulls those 5 templates from g90digi and
ships them in g90-image/node-portal-templates/. The
bootstrap's existing `*.html` glob picks them up
automatically.

Effect: launcher app help links (FLrig, JS8Call, FLDigi,
WSJT-X) now load instead of 500. The /scan wifi page
renders the scan results.
